members.default: { featureWidgetId: {type: "reference" as const, selector: "webwriter-feature-engineering", label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("Feature source")}, modelWidgetId: {type: "reference" as const, selector: "webwriter-model-designing", label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("Design source")}, editMode: { type: "select" as const, label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("Edit permissions"), options: [ {value: "edit", label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("Edit everything")}, {value: "hidden", label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("Hide widget")}, ], }, currentBackend: { type: "select" as const, label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("Preferred backend"), options: [ {value: "cpu", label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("CPU")}, {value: "webgl", label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("WebGL (GPU)")}, ], }, cache: {type: Boolean, label: (widget: Labelled) => widget.msg("Cache training samples")}, }

members.name: #data
members.description: Stores the model jsons with a name like "best" or "epoch-20" for loading by the inference and test widgets

members.name: featureWidgetId
members.description: The feature engineering widget to use as data source for training the model.

members.name: modelWidgetId
members.description: The model design widget to use as model source for training.

members.name: cache
members.description: If true, the transformed training samples will be cached for faster training.

members.name: currentBackend
members.description: The prefered tfjs backend

members.name: editMode
members.description: "edit" means that students can use the widget to train a model while "hidden" means the widget will be invisible to student but the trained models can be used by other widgets.

members.name: isTraining
members.description: Is true, while tf is in the training process

members.name: currentTraining
members.description: contains the currently trained model

members.name: backendPriority
members.description: A list of available backends for tf to use. Could be expanded and are tried out in order. (Not all backends support all layer and operation types, but can provide better training speed)

members.name: buildModel
members.description: Builds the complete tfjs model using the layers from the model design widget. It sets the correct input names for the input layers as "in_<feature>". The output layers dependency graph is build and the loss is applied to the output tensor for training.

members.name: getModel

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The checkpoint name like "best" or "epoch-20". All the available checkpoints can be retrieved via this.getAvailableModels().

members.description: Returns the model for named checkpoints for other widgets to use.

members.name: getAvailableModels
members.description: Returns the available model checkpoints

members.name: clearModels
members.description: Deletes all model checkpoints

members.name: resetModel
members.description: Sets the state of this training widget back to the initial configuration and deletes previous training progress.

members.name: initModel
members.description: Initializes the model for training and preps the UI.

members.name: training
members.description: Runs the tf training loop and keeps the UI up-to-date

members.name: saveCurrentModel
members.description: Saves the current model as a checkpoint for other widgets to use later.

events.name: finished
events.description: Fired when the training process has finished.

events.name: epoch
events.description: Fired after each epoch during training.
